alerts.text: Cost per purchase is running away: $244 over 30 days, $349 over 3 days, $654 month to date. The batch is fatiguing, kill the losers in the per-ad table.
32 purchases in 30 days but 0 calls booked from them. The purchase-to-call step is broken or untracked. Every dollar of front-end spend is stranded until this works.
0 sales on $6,289 lifetime spend, 4 booked calls total. The leak is after the webinar, not in the ads.
CPL roughly doubled: $132 over 7 days vs $82 over 30, about 1 lead a day since Jun 28.
Show rate slipped to 37% over 7 days vs 45% over 30. Booked calls are not showing up.
Meta disabled 5 ad accounts for unusual activity, including the old ELYSIUM JET account.
Per-ad numbers below are TRUE data straight from the Creatives tabs (CRM and EverWebinar attribution), not Meta-reported.

offers.name: CJ Challenge
offers.eyebrow: Low-ticket front end, GHL paid-attributed truth
offers.lag_note: Purchases land fast, but the high-ticket backend (calls, sales) lags weeks. Judge front end on cost per purchase.
offers.flag: 0 calls booked from 32 purchases in 30 days. The purchase-to-call step is broken or untracked.

cpa.label: Cost per purchase
cpa.bench: Average order is about $198, so target near breakeven on the front end.

roas.label: Front-end true ROAS
roas.bench: 1.0x means the challenge pays for its own ads. Profit comes from the backend calls.

offers.read: This is where most Channel Junkies money goes and it needs attention. Cost per purchase jumped from $244 over 30 days to $654 month to date, so July's spend is buying half the customers June's did. The bigger problem is the backend: 32 purchases and 0 booked calls means the high-ticket step this funnel exists for is not happening. Kill the fatigued ads in the table below, and fix or instrument the purchase-to-call flow before scaling anything.

offers.name: Elysium Jet Academy
offers.lag_note: Sales lag booked calls by up to 14 days. Short windows are judged on cost per booked call and show rate.

costAppt.label: Cost per booked call
costAppt.bench: $33 average appointment, $40-60 per qualified call is the industry target.

costSale.label: Cost per sale
costSale.bench: Close rate 10-25% of calls taken is the healthy band.

offers.read: The winner. 6.45x true ROAS over 3 days, 3.84x over 30 on $21.6k spend. The scale rule allows about a 20% raise every 3-4 days while 7d ROAS holds above target. Fix the show-rate slide in parallel, every point of show rate is free revenue at this volume.

offers.name: True Success Academy
offers.lag_note: Sales lag registrations by about 7 days. Short windows are judged on leads, stay-to-end, and booked calls.

cpl.label: Cost per lead
cpl.bench: Webinar registrants average around $72. Under $30 is strong.

costStay.label: Cost per stay-to-end
costStay.bench: House target until sales data exists.

costCall.label: Cost per booked call
costCall.bench: $40-60 per qualified call is the industry target. High-ticket webinar funnels run higher.

offers.read: Front of funnel improved a lot this week: CPL near $20 and stay-to-end 68% over 3 days. But lifetime it is $6,289 spent, 4 calls, 0 sales. The webinar-to-call step is the bottleneck. Do not scale spend until that converts, better ads just burn faster.

offers.name: CJ Grader
offers.lag_note: Purchases lag leads by about 3 days. Short windows are judged on cost per lead.
offers.flag: No true purchase column is flowing on this tab, so Grader can only be judged on leads for now.

cpl.label: Cost per lead
cpl.bench: Industry lead-form CPL runs $27-38. High-ticket runs higher.

offers.read: CPL roughly doubled in the last week and lead volume fell to about 1 a day since Jun 28. Likely creative fatigue or a losing new batch. Kill the dead ads in the table below and refresh creative.

tsa.name: This is for consultants making money...
